_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §FC] Sneaking, hiding and dousing in the crawler (Mike, 6 Oct, 22:32; his Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs and Minecraft references). Brings §DF (your light gives you away) underground. First guesses by Claude (chat), 6 Oct night; the designer owns them.
_help.sneak: §FC.1 (Mike): Shift held sneaks (the crawler's crouch, as built: crouch speed, noise_level 0.1). camera_ease_s: the view eases down to crouched eye height and back up, never a snap. reticle: the sneak look of hud.json's reticle (ring = the dot opens into a small ring; dim = its alpha scale). footstep_volume: a share of the walk's step volume. ledge_guard: while sneaking you can't walk off a drop deeper than ledge_drop_m; let go of Shift to step off (Minecraft).
_help.hide: §FC.2 (Mike): things to hide behind and in. Claude's first guess: no hide button and no prompt; hidden means out of a creature's sight line (cover lists the kinds the tomb kit should leave room behind). A lit torch gives you away behind cover too (§DF).
_help.douse: §FC.3 (Mike): put your own torch out on purpose and keep holding it (key in hands.json douse_key). log_line: the one log line. Relight from any lit flame, as built (§CN, §ET.7).
